Hey Guys, I recently got a electric barbecue grill and want to test it out. What can I do without a lot effort and money? btw. I don't eat meat, so it has to be vegetable.

Thanks a lot ;)
What can I make for barbecue this evening?
Stuffed peppers on the grill - absolutely delicious!

Grilled zucchini and squash, slice them medium thickness, add your favorite seasoning then grill to your liking. I also love sauteed green beans with garlic. Heat up some olive oil and throw in the minced garlic, once the garlic is translucent mix in all the green beans, saute till the green beans are done.

Post pics to /v/grilling and /v/bbq
Slice an eggplant, add salt and pepper. Zucchini, artichoke, asparagus, all forms of squash. If it fits on the grill, slap it on there.

Asparagus is really great on the grill, personally I like it raw but you can sprinkle some olive oil and some seasoning if you like.

Also zucchini does very well, cut in half long ways and get a few sear marks on the cut side.

Artichokes also do well, you will probably want to wrap them in foil though.

Take a slab of baby back ribs and season with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, chili powder, garlic, and diced shallots. Add a little water or beer or seasoning liquid (dales is good but pretty salty). Wrap it in aluminum foil (sealed) and cook it in the oven at 300 degrees for 2 hours. Once it's done take it out throw it on the grill (bones up) for 10-15 minutes to crisp the top. Cut into ribs of two and then give it away to someone who appreciates real food.
For a side, Broccoli Slaw is awesome. It's got a great texture and you can use a lot less mayo/oil/fat than other slaws.
